slides.texte_overlay:
quiet signs you're smarter
than you think

you enjoy being alone

you can spend an afternoon with your own thoughts without feeling bored. a mind that entertains itself is usually a mind with plenty going on inside it.

you change your mind

when someone shows you good evidence, you update your opinion without a fight. being able to say i was wrong is one of the rarest and clearest signs of intelligence.

you ask a lot of questions

you can't hear about something new without wanting to know how it works. constant questions are the quiet habit behind almost every brilliant mind in history.

you crave new ideas

you get restless when life feels too repetitive, so you feed your mind something new every day, a planet, a painting, a myth, and it keeps you sharp and happy.
slides.texte_sophia:
you crave new ideas

you crave new ideas. the Sophia app turns that into one short lesson a day, a planet or a painting, and 5 minutes is enough to keep a restless mind happy.

slides.texte_overlay:
you notice patterns

you spot links between things that seem unrelated: a song and a memory, a habit and a mood. seeing patterns quickly is a quiet but powerful kind of intelligence.
